description: 31/10/23 Gazmatek Halloween Here some infos for the party : Halloween is coming so prepare your best disguise ! We will make a contest of the most beautiful disguise and a stand of make up will be on place !! • 1 price : you choose two vinyls color edition or hoodies Gazmatek and free entry for next party. • 2 price : 1 vinyl or T-shirt Gazmatek • 3 price : Lanyards or 6 cup Gazmatek What could you except ? • Roller show. • Big Mapping show all night. • Good vibes. • Prevention stand. • Good tekno music provided by Gazmatek and Falc’ohm. • And an amazing place for party with us Entrance is 20€ for casuals people and 15€ for people in disguise , don’t be afraid the ridicule does not kill !! It’s an event only CASH for entrance for bar for everythings. Not under 18, this time ID will be checked. Not own drink. No drugs. No pets. No violence , you will have a punch for this. No discrimination , no sexisme ! We are all free people !! Smoke area outside. Take care of your friends Please Respect the place, organisation and artists If you want to talk to an artist please wait the end of his show, not during Line up if you discover all artists would be playing we offer two drinks. Get a flyer or fill it up at the entrance ! 2 artists are not from Gazmatek. Only one try per person don’t even think to sent a message on our box for this, we have others things to do U. _ _ _ _ _ _ mix _ E _ _ _ mix _ _ W _ _ _ live _ _ _ C _ _ live _ _ _ _B _ _ _ mix/live _ _ _ _ _K live _ _ - _ R _ _ _ _ _ live _ _ _ N _ _ mix _ _O _ _ mix _ R _ _ _ _ _’ _ live Let’s the play begin … And see you all with your worst face for Halloween Open doors at 21h00 First artist playing at 22h00 End of the show 08h00 Can’t wait  Bruxelles
